Now, in the 布洛克斯山 you know where you are, it’s quite convenient, really. I mean, there’s old Ilsa up on her rock keeping watch, and Henry happy to be on his heights, not to mention the Snorers snorting at Misery. Things there stay put for eons on end; you can count on it. But here it’s all a turmoil. The earth blows up under you without a warning. I mean, I’m walking along through a valley, flat as a pancake, when all of sudden a mountain pokes up in back of me— well, maybe not a mountain, exactly, but large enough to part me from my 斯芬克斯们. Ah, but I see more fires flickering there down the valley, signaling the call to adventure. The saucy little chorus is still there, dancing, swaying, tempting and enticing me with their coquetry. Easy does it, now. Too much noshing can spoil you. Soon you can’t forego an opportunity.

@@U03373@@
(Drawing 梅菲斯特 after them.)

@@U03374@@
Onward, still onward, Faster and faster! Then with a spiteful Coyness delaying, Prattling and playing, He'll think he’s the winner. It’s so delightful To see the old sinner Lured and seduced! Fretting and groaning, His clubfoot bemoaning, Hear, he comes grumbling, Stumbling and tumbling!
translation:
@@U03371@@
现在，在布洛克斯山你知道自己在哪里，真的很方便。我的意思是，老伊尔莎在她的岩石上守望，亨利很高兴能站在他的高度，更不用说打鼾者对苦难打喷嚏了。那里的东西永远保持着原样；您可以信赖它。但这里却一片混乱。大地在你脚下毫无征兆地爆炸。我的意思是，我正沿着山谷行走，平坦得像煎饼一样，突然一座山在我身后出现——嗯，确切地说，也许不是一座山，但足够大，足以将我和斯芬克斯一家分开。啊，但我看到山谷下方有更多的火焰在闪烁，这是对冒险的召唤。俏皮的小合唱团还在，舞动着，摇摆着，用她们的撒娇诱惑着我。现在就很容易做到。吃太多东西会毁了你。很快你就不能放弃机会了。

@@U03373@@
（在他们之后画梅菲斯特。）

@@U03374@@
继续，继续，更快，更快！然后，随着恶意的腼腆的拖延、喋喋不休和玩耍，他会认为自己是赢家。看到老罪人被诱惑，真是令人高兴！烦躁和呻吟，他的畸形足在哀叹，听着，他抱怨着来了，跌跌撞撞！
